purpose: Measure the completed three-router and on-demand-library journey before proposing convenience or coordination infrastructure.

serial.implementation: existing serial invocation of the selected read-only skill closures
serial.mutation_policy: read-only lenses may run serially; any mutation and final verification remain serial
serial.required_final_outcome: all member artifacts plus one synthesized correctness verdict

existing_batched.mutation_policy: independent read-only members only; mutation remains outside the batch
existing_batched.required_final_outcome: independently attributable member artifacts plus one synthesized correctness verdict

representative_router_journeys: which-cleanup -> bounded closeout and guard handoff

correctness.observation: frozen route gates plus final artifact/verification rubric

completion.observation: all required final artifacts and terminal statuses

wall_time_ms.observation: monotonic elapsed time per condition and end-to-end pair

controlled_context_utf8_bytes.observation: exact UTF-8 bytes of task packets, prompts, guides, and shared context deliberately injected

repeated_context_utf8_bytes.observation: exact injected byte sequences repeated across calls in one condition

native_tool_invocations.observation: count from command/event records; repeated identical commands remain separate invocations

human_interventions.observation: count and classify approvals, clarifications, retries, and manual repair choices

recoverable_failures.observation: count with command, symptom, repair, and whether the documented path was sufficient

correctness_gates: 100% of clear corpus cases route as frozen
every ambiguous case stays within its allowed set or asks a discriminating question
zero heavy false positives on direct/no-skill cases
every selected closure path exists and matches capability truth
all final artifacts, native checks, source-preservation, and failure-honesty rubrics pass

p9_adoption_threshold.performance: at least 20% median wall-time reduction or 30% controlled-context reduction
p9_adoption_threshold.correctness: all P8 correctness gates remain green

decision: measure-only; no router, coordinator, updater, or host-guidance behavior changes are authorized by this protocol
